scientific_integrity: A deterministic finite-graph theorem with an analytical proof; a self-review is not independent validation. The published sigmoidal model and classical persistence tools are acknowledged as prior art.
scientific_limitations: The \(2^n+1\) stable-equilibrium count is a lower bound for each fixed graph and 1<delta<4 at sufficiently large gamma. Other equilibria are not excluded for \(n\ge2\); basins are determined only for \(n=1\). No finite gamma bound uniform over network size or empirical claim is asserted.
title: Exponential polarized attractors with balanced opposing zealots
